name: Faust I Director four-line sentence
source_sentence:
Ihr beyden die ihr mir so oft,
In Noth und Trübsal, beygestanden,
Sagt was ihr wohl, in deutschen Landen,
Von unsrer Unternehmung hofft?
sentence_translation: Both of you who have so often stood by me in need and tribulation, say what you hope from our undertaking in German lands?
